description: This Java class manages configuration for JWT subject issuers within a security/authentication context, including methods to load configurations from various sources and retrieve specific issuer configurations.

classes.name: JwtSubjectIssuersConfig
classes.description: Immutable class holding configuration details for multiple JWT subject issuers, including methods for loading and querying issuer configurations.

methods.name: fromJwtSubjectIssuerConfigs
methods.description: Creates an instance from a collection of JwtSubjectIssuerConfig objects, using a default protocol.

methods.name: fromOAuthConfig
methods.description: Creates an instance from an OAuthConfig object, merging default and extension issuer configurations.

methods.name: getConfigItem
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration for a specific issuer, if available.

methods.name: getConfigItems (overload)
methods.description: Returns configuration items matching the specified SubjectIssuer.
